ModuleClass.name: threeDDisplay
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to give the information of a 3D display.

DataPoint.name: threeDDisplayType
DataPoint.Doc: The type of 3D display technology (see clause 5.6.52)

DataPoint.name: threeDDisplayViewAngle
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates viewing angle of the 3D display (1..360)

DataPoint.name: threeDDisplayResolutionX
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates resolution of X-axis of the 3D display.

DataPoint.name: threeDDisplayResolutionY
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates resolution of Y-axis of the 3D display.

DataPoint.name: threeDGlasses
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the 3D display uses 3D glasses (TRUE) or not.

ModuleClass.name: threeDPrinter
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for a 3D printer.

Action.name: start3Dprint
Action.Doc: Start 3D printing.

Action.name: stop3Dprint
Action.Doc: Stop 3D printing.

DataPoint.name: printType
DataPoint.Doc: The type of printing technology.

DataPoint.name: printSizeX
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the maximum size of a printing object in the direction of X-axis.

DataPoint.name: printSizeY
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the maximum size of printing object in the direction of Y-axis.

DataPoint.name: printSizeZ
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the maximum size of printing object in the direction of Z-axis.

DataPoint.name: network
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the Wide Area Network (WAN) connectivity of the 3D printer, such as Internet or GSM. "False" indicates that the printer does not have network connectivity to a WAN. "True" indicates that the printer has WAN network connectivity.

DataPoint.name: memorySize
DataPoint.Doc: This value represents the total memory size of the printer.

ModuleClass.name: threeDScanner
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to scanning 3D object for the user.

DataPoint.name: threeDScannerType
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates type of the 3D scanner

DataPoint.name: threeDScanResolution
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the scanning resolution.

DataPoint.name: maxSizeX
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the maximum horizontal size of the scanning.

DataPoint.name: maxSizeY
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the maximum vertical size of the scanning.

DataPoint.name: maxSizeZ
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the maximum depth of the scanning.

ModuleClass.name: acousticSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for an acoustic sensor.

DataPoint.name: acousticStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The acousticStatus is expressed in percent, whereas a value of 0 means "no sound" and a value of 100 means "most noisy".

ModuleClass.name: airConJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of an air conditioner.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: Currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of the current job mode as a string. This can be used when currentJobMode is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: airFlow
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for controlling the air flow of a device.

DataPoint.name: speed
DataPoint.Doc: The current speed level in the range of the [minSpeed, maxSpeed] data points.

DataPoint.name: minSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: The minimum value for the speed level. If not present, the default is 0.

DataPoint.name: maxSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: The maximum value for the speed level. If not present, the default is 100.

DataPoint.name: verticalDirection
DataPoint.Doc: The vertical direction of the air flow.

DataPoint.name: supportedVerticalDirection
DataPoint.Doc: List of supported vertical directions.

DataPoint.name: horizontalDirection
DataPoint.Doc: The horizontal direction of the air flow.

DataPoint.name: supportedHorizontalDirection
DataPoint.Doc: List of supported horizontal directions.

DataPoint.name: automode
DataPoint.Doc: Status of the automode feature. "True" indicates that the speed is set by the device, "False" indicates that the device is not controlling the speed.

ModuleClass.name: airPurifierJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of an airPurifier.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: Currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of the current job mode as a string. This can be used when currentJobMode is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: airQualitySensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for a monitoring sensor that measures the air quality.

DataPoint.name: monitoringEnabled
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of monitoring. "True" indicates enabled, and "False" indicates not enabled.

DataPoint.name: pm1
DataPoint.Doc: The concentration of particle matter under 1um. The minimum value is 0, and the maximum value is 1000.

DataPoint.name: pm25
DataPoint.Doc: The concentration of particle matter under 2,5um. The minimum value is 0, and the maximum value is 1000.

DataPoint.name: pm10
DataPoint.Doc: The concentration of particle matter under 10um. The minimum value is 0, and the maximum value is 1000.

DataPoint.name: tsp
DataPoint.Doc: Total suspended particles.

DataPoint.name: odor
DataPoint.Doc: The concentration of odor that reflects air pollution. The minimum value is 0.

DataPoint.name: humidity
DataPoint.Doc: The measured humidity. The minimum value is 0, and the maximum value is 100.

DataPoint.name: temperature
DataPoint.Doc: The current temperature.

DataPoint.name: airPressure
DataPoint.Doc: The current temperature.

DataPoint.name: co
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the CO level.

DataPoint.name: co2
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the CO2 level.

DataPoint.name: ch2o
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the CH2O level.

DataPoint.name: voc
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the VOC (Volatile Organic Compounds).

DataPoint.name: no2
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the concentration of NO2.

DataPoint.name: so2
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the concentration of SO2.

DataPoint.name: o3
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the concentration of O3.

DataPoint.name: noise
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the level of noise.

DataPoint.name: windDirection
DataPoint.Doc: The wind direction. The value range is [0-359]. North is 0,0 degrees, east is 90,0 degrees, south is 180.0 degrees, west is 270.0 degrees.

DataPoint.name: windSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: The wind speed.

ModuleClass.name: alarmSpeaker
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to initiate and monitor an alarm.

DataPoint.name: tone
DataPoint.Doc: Representing the tones of the alarm.

DataPoint.name: light
DataPoint.Doc: Representing the lighting mode of the alarm.

DataPoint.name: alarmStatus
DataPoint.Doc: "True" indicates the alarm start while "False" indicates the alarm stop.

ModuleClass.name: anemometer
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate the measure of the wind speed.

DataPoint.name: windSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: The speed of the wind.

ModuleClass.name: audioVolume
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor volume.

Action.name: upVolume
Action.Doc: Increase volume by the amount of the stepValue up to the maxValue.

Action.name: downVolume
Action.Doc: Decrease volume by the amount of the stepValue down to 0.

Action.name: muteAudioVolume
Action.Doc: Save the current audio volume and set the volume to 0.

DataPoint.name: volumeValue
DataPoint.Doc: The current volume in the range of [0, maxValue]. 0 shall mean no sound produced.

DataPoint.name: stepValue
DataPoint.Doc: Step value used by the "UpVolume" and "DownVolume" actions.

DataPoint.name: maxValue
DataPoint.Doc: Maximum value allowed for Volume. maxValue is 100 by default if "maxValue" is not provided.

DataPoint.name: muteEnabled
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of the mute enablement. "True" indicates enabled (that is, no sound), and "False" indicates not enabled (that is, sound is played).

DataPoint.name: saveAudioVolume
DataPoint.Doc: Save the current audio volume for the muteAudioVolume.

ModuleClass.name: autoDocumentFeeder
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to monitor the state of autoDocumentFeeder (ADF). ADF is a feature which takes several pages and feeds the paper one page at a time into a scanner or printer, allowing the user to scan, print or fax, multiple-page documents without having to manually replace each page.

DataPoint.name: currentAdfState
DataPoint.Doc: Current state of the ADF.

DataPoint.name: adfStates
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible ADF states that are supported by the device.

ModuleClass.name: barometer
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to measure the atmospheric pressure and indicate the detection of abnormal pressure, and raise an alarm if a triggering criterion is met.

DataPoint.name: alarm
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the status of detection of an abnormal pressure. “True” indicates an abnormal pressure, “False” indicates a normal pressure.

DataPoint.name: atmosphericPressure
DataPoint.Doc: To report the value of the atmospheric pressure.

DataPoint.name: minPressureThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The min threshold to trigger the alarm.

DataPoint.name: maxPressureThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The max threshold to trigger the alarm.

ModuleClass.name: battery
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to indicate the detection of low battery and gives an alarm if triggering criterion is met. The level data point in the module represents the current battery charge level.

DataPoint.name: level
DataPoint.Doc: TThe rounded percentage of the current charging level of a battery in the range of [0, 100]. 0 percentage shall mean that no charge remains.

DataPoint.name: capacity
DataPoint.Doc: The total capacity of a battery in mAh.

DataPoint.name: rechargeable
DataPoint.Doc: To indicate the battery is rechargeable or not. "True" indicates rechargeable.

DataPoint.name: charging
DataPoint.Doc: The status of charging. "True" indicates charging, and "False" indicates not charging.

DataPoint.name: discharging
DataPoint.Doc: The status of discharging. "True" indicates discharging, and "False" indicates not discharging.

DataPoint.name: lowBattery
DataPoint.Doc: To indicate that the battery is in a low charge level.

DataPoint.name: batteryThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: When a battery's "level" is less than "batteryThreshold" then the "lowBattery" is "true". This datapoint can be used to raise an alarm, depending on the implementation.

DataPoint.name: chargingVoltage
DataPoint.Doc: The voltage to charge the battery

DataPoint.name: chargingAmpere
DataPoint.Doc: The ampere to charge the battery

DataPoint.name: dischargingVoltage
DataPoint.Doc: The voltage to discharge the battery

DataPoint.name: dischargingAmpere
DataPoint.Doc: The ampere to discharge the battery

DataPoint.name: batteryMaterial
DataPoint.Doc: The material of the cell of the battery

DataPoint.name: batteryShape
DataPoint.Doc: The size of the battery such as "AAA".

ModuleClass.name: billDeposit
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to deposit bills, indicates the balance of the deposited bills and detects fake.

DataPoint.name: depositStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the deposit is made successfully or not.

DataPoint.name: balance
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the balance of the deposited bills.

DataPoint.name: count
DataPoint.Doc: The data point indicates the number of bills which are deposited. [1..N].

DataPoint.name: currency
DataPoint.Doc: The currency is depended on the country which the deposited bills are used. For example, the currency could be "Dollar" in US, "Euro" in EU and "Won" in Korea.

DataPoint.name: fakeStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates that the deposited bills are fake notes.

ModuleClass.name: billWithdrawal
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to withdraw bills which are deposited by the billDepositModule.

DataPoint.name: withdrawalStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the withdrawal is made successfully or not.

DataPoint.name: balance
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the balance of the withdrawn bills.

DataPoint.name: count
DataPoint.Doc: The data point indicates the number of bills which are withdrawn. [1..N].

ModuleClass.name: binaryObject
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass describes the handling of a binary object (blob).

DataPoint.name: object
DataPoint.Doc: This data point contains the base64 encoded binary object.

DataPoint.name: objectType
DataPoint.Doc: This data point contains the type and subtype of the binary object as a MIME type.

DataPoint.name: size
DataPoint.Doc: The size of the decoded binary object.

DataPoint.name: hash
DataPoint.Doc: The hash code of the blob. If present, it is used to check the decoded content of the "object" data point for integrity. The algorithm used for generating the hash value is SHA-2. The data point contains the hash as a hex encoded value.

ModuleClass.name: binarySwitch
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor the state of power.

Action.name: toggle
Action.Doc: Toggle the switch.

DataPoint.name: state
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of the binarySwitch. "True" indicates turned-on, and "False" indicates turned-off.

ModuleClass.name: bioElectricalImpedanceAnalysis
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the analysis of human body tissue based on impedance measurement.

DataPoint.name: water
DataPoint.Doc: The water content measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: fat
DataPoint.Doc: The fat content measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: muscle
DataPoint.Doc: The muscle content measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: bone
DataPoint.Doc: The bone content measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: visceraFat
DataPoint.Doc: The viscera fat content measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: kcal
DataPoint.Doc: The kcal (kilocalories) measurement from the BIA.

DataPoint.name: resistance
DataPoint.Doc: The resistance measurement of a human body.

ModuleClass.name: blender
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass is for controlling a blender, for example in a juicer.

DataPoint.name: useBlender
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of the blender enablement. "True" indicates enabled, and "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: spinSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: Choose the right spin speed according to the hardness of the object (eg.fruits and vegetables).

ModuleClass.name: bodyCompositionAnalyser
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: bodyLength
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of body length by Weight scale and Body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: bmi
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of Body Mass Index (BMI) by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: fatFreeMass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of fat free mass by a Weight scale and a Body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: softLeanMass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of soft lean mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: muscleMass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of muscle mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: basalMetabolism
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of muscle mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: impedance
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of impedance by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: mass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: bodyWaterMass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of body water mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: inorganicSaltMass
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of inorganic salt mass by a weight scale and a body composition analyser.

DataPoint.name: somatotype
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of somatotype by Weight scale and Body composition analyser.

ModuleClass.name: boiler
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to control the status of the boiling functionality for water heaters.

DataPoint.name: status
DataPoint.Doc: The status of boiling. "True" indicates boiling, "False" indicates not boiling.

ModuleClass.name: brewing
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor a brewing process. It is intended to be part of devices that prepare hot drinks such as a coffee or a tea.

DataPoint.name: cupsNumber
DataPoint.Doc: The current number of the cups requested to brew.

DataPoint.name: strength
DataPoint.Doc: The current strength of the drink taste. A higher value indicates a stronger taste.

ModuleClass.name: brightness
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor the brightness of a light for example from a lamp. Brightness is scaled as a percentage. A lamp or a monitor can be adjusted to a level of light between very dim (0 % is the minimum brightness) and very bright (100 % is the maximum brightness).

DataPoint.name: brightness
DataPoint.Doc: The status of brightness level.

ModuleClass.name: cardScanner
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to scan an image of a card, gets the card information from the image and provides the information.

DataPoint.name: scanStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the scanning process is successful.

DataPoint.name: cardInfo
DataPoint.Doc: The card information is a string value.

ModuleClass.name: cashDispenser
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to withdraw designated amount of cash or returns all the deposited bills and coins by the billDepositModule and coinDepositModule.

DataPoint.name: dispenseStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the dispense is successful or not.

DataPoint.name: balance
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the balance of the dispensed bills and coins.

DataPoint.name: count
DataPoint.Doc: The data point indicates the number of bills and coins which are dispensed.

DataPoint.name: currency
DataPoint.Doc: The currency is depended on the country that the dispensed bills and coins are used. For example, the unit could be "Dollar" in US, "Euro" in EU and "Won" in Korea.

ModuleClass.name: clock
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor time and date information.

DataPoint.name: currentTime
DataPoint.Doc: Information of the current time.

DataPoint.name: currentDate
DataPoint.Doc: Information of the current date.

DataPoint.name: currentTimeZone
DataPoint.Doc: Name of current time zone according to the IANA Timezone data format (TZ), for example, "America/New York".

ModuleClass.name: clothesDryerJobMode

ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job mode of a washer.

DataPoint.name: jobModes

ModuleClass.name: clothesWasherJobModeOption
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the washing job mode options of a washer.

DataPoint.name: washTemp
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the water temperature level.

DataPoint.name: soilLevel
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the washing level.

DataPoint.name: spinSpeed
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the spin-dry speed level.

DataPoint.name: preWash
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates pre-wash. "True" indicates enabled, "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: speedWash
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates speed wash. "True" indicates enabled, "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: steamTreat
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates steam treat. "True" indicates enabled, "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: coldWash
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates cold wash. "True" indicates enabled, "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: extraRinse
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates extra rinse. "True" indicates enabled, "False" indicates disabled.

ModuleClass.name: coinDeposit
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to deposit coins, indicates the balance of the deposited coins and detects fake.

DataPoint.name: depositStatus
DataPoint.Doc: TThis data point indicates the deposit is made successfully or not.

DataPoint.name: balance

DataPoint.name: count
DataPoint.Doc: The data point indicates the number of coins which are deposited.

ModuleClass.name: colour
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to set the value of the Red, Green, and Blue colour channels for a colour device.

DataPoint.name: red
DataPoint.Doc: The value of the Red colour channel of RGB. The range is [0,255].

DataPoint.name: green
DataPoint.Doc: The value of the Green colour channel of RGB. The range is [0,255].

DataPoint.name: blue
DataPoint.Doc: TThe value of the Blue colour channel of RGB. The range is [0,255].

ModuleClass.name: colourSaturation
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor a colour saturation value.

DataPoint.name: colourSaturation
DataPoint.Doc: The status of colour saturation level. "colourSaturation" has a range of [0,100]. A "colourSaturation" value of 0 means that a device displays or produces black and white images. A "colourSaturation" value of 50 means that a device displays or produces normal colour images. A "colourSaturation" value of 100 means that a device displays or produces very colourful images.

ModuleClass.name: connectivity
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to monitor network connectivity.

DataPoint.name: rsrp
DataPoint.Doc: Reference signal received power (RSRP) is a measurement of the received power level in an LTE cell network.

DataPoint.name: rsrq
DataPoint.Doc: Reference signal received quality (RSRQ) indicates the quality of the received reference signal. RSRQ is defined as the ratio NxRSRP/(E-UTRA carrier RSSI), where N is the number of RB's of the E-UTRA carrier RSSI measurement bandwidth. The measurements in the numerator and denominator shall be made over the same set of resource blocks.

DataPoint.name: cellID
DataPoint.Doc: Serving Cell ID in case Network Bearer Resource is a Cellular Network.

DataPoint.name: rssi
DataPoint.Doc: In telecommunications, received signal strength indicator (RSSI) is a measurement of the power present in a received radio signal.

DataPoint.name: signalECL
DataPoint.Doc: ased on measurements of the reference signal's received power, the UE will select an entry coverage enhancement level (ECL) to camp into the cell. The coverage level will determine the Narrowband Physical Random Access Channel (NPRACH) resources used by the device and will inform the eNB of the device receiver sensitivity conditions.

DataPoint.name: sinr
DataPoint.Doc: Signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) is commonly used in wireless communication as a way to measure the quality of wireless connections.

DataPoint.name: pci
DataPoint.Doc: Physical Cell ID is an identification of a cell at physical layer.

DataPoint.name: dailyActivityTime
DataPoint.Doc: Daily communication time (Starts at 00:00h).

DataPoint.name: dailyNumberOfConnections
DataPoint.Doc: Daily number of connections (Starts at 00:00h).

DataPoint.name: commFreqValue
DataPoint.Doc: Communication frequency value (commFreqValue) is the transmission frequency of the wireless signal.

DataPoint.name: currentCycleBeginn
DataPoint.Doc: A timestamp that indicates the beginning of the current cycle for counting the transfer volumina and transmission errors.

DataPoint.name: currentCycleVolume
DataPoint.Doc: Number of bytes transferred since currentCycleBeginn.

DataPoint.name: currentCycleTransmissionErrors
DataPoint.Doc: Number of transmission errors since currentCycleBeginn.

DataPoint.name: minimumCommunicationLatency
DataPoint.Doc: The minimum time delay between the last communication attempt.

ModuleClass.name: cookerHoodJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of a cookerHood.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: The name of the current job mode as a string. This can be used when currentJobMode is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: credentials
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to manage user credentials which allows a user to authenticate on an appliance or a server that is associated with the appliance. The authentication depends on a user login and password, or on a token. An example appliance which may include this ModuleClass is a camera.

DataPoint.name: loginName
DataPoint.Doc: The user's login name.

DataPoint.name: password
DataPoint.Doc: The user's password.

DataPoint.name: token
DataPoint.Doc: An authentication token, for example an OAuth token.

ModuleClass.name: crossingBarrier
ModuleClass.Doc: An active barrier is used to block a pedestrian or vehicle from a control point (e.g. entrance and gate).

DataPoint.name: barrierDefault
DataPoint.Doc: The value of the barrier default is true, the default status of the barrier is closed and vice versa.

DataPoint.name: barrierStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The value of the barrier status is true, the barrier is closed and vice versa.

DataPoint.name: timer
DataPoint.Doc: The timer indicates the duration of barrierStatus is changed. This means that barrierStatus is set to the current value of barrierDefault.

ModuleClass.name: dehumidifierJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of a dehumidifier device.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: The name of the current job mode as a string. This can be used when currentJobMode is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: dishWasherJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of a dishWasher.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: The name of the current job mode as a string. This can be used when the currentJobMode is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: disposal
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control the status of the disposing functionality for garbage disposal.

DataPoint.name: disposalStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The status of disposal. "True" indicates disposing, "False" indicates not disposing.

ModuleClass.name: doorStatus
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the status of a door. It is intended to be part of a device such as a refrigerator and an oven that might have multiple doors.

DataPoint.name: doorState
DataPoint.Doc: Current state of the door

DataPoint.name: openDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The time duration the door has been open.

DataPoint.name: openAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The state of the door open alarm. "True" indicates that the open alarm is active. "False" indicates that the open alarm is not active.

ModuleClass.name: electricVehicleConnector
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information about charging/discharging devices for electric vehicles.

DataPoint.name: status
DataPoint.Doc: The status of connection. "True" means connected, "False" means not connected.

DataPoint.name: chargingCapacity
DataPoint.Doc: Rated charging capacity. The unit of measure is ampere hours.

DataPoint.name: dischargingCapacity
DataPoint.Doc: Rated discharging capacity.

ModuleClass.name: energyConsumption
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass describes the measured energy consumed by the device since power up. One particular use case for the energyConsumption ModuleClass is a smart meter.

DataPoint.name: power
DataPoint.Doc: The power of the device.

DataPoint.name: absoluteEnergyConsumption
DataPoint.Doc: The absolute energy consumption, reflecting the real measurement of accumulative energy.

DataPoint.name: roundingEnergyConsumption
DataPoint.Doc: This energy consumption data is calculated by multiplying significantDigits with multiplyingFactors, and rounding down the result.

DataPoint.name: significantDigits
DataPoint.Doc: The number of effective digits for data.

DataPoint.name: multiplyingFactors
DataPoint.Doc: The unit for data multiplying factors, for example 1 kWh, 0,1 kWh, 0,01 kWh, etc.

DataPoint.name: voltage
DataPoint.Doc: The voltage of the device.

DataPoint.name: current
DataPoint.Doc: The current of the device.

DataPoint.name: frequency
DataPoint.Doc: The frequency of the device.

DataPoint.name: measuringScope
DataPoint.Doc: The measuring scope of the meter, for example the whole house, a room, or a device.

ModuleClass.name: energyGeneration
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information about generation data on electric generator devices such as a photo voltaic power system, fuel cells, or microgeneration.

DataPoint.name: powerGenerationData
DataPoint.Doc: Amount of instantaneous generation data.

DataPoint.name: roundingEnergyGeneration
DataPoint.Doc: This energy consumption data is calculated by multiplying significantDigits with multiplyingFactors, and rounding down the result.

DataPoint.name: significantDigits
DataPoint.Doc: The number of effective digits for data.

DataPoint.name: multiplyingFactors
DataPoint.Doc: The unit for data multiplying factors, for example. 1 kWh, 0,1 kWh, 0,01 kWh, etc.

DataPoint.name: generationSource
DataPoint.Doc: The type of generating source.

ModuleClass.name: faultDetection
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information about whether a fault has occurred in a device.

DataPoint.name: status
DataPoint.Doc: Status of fault detection.

DataPoint.name: code
DataPoint.Doc: The numeric representation of the fault.

DataPoint.name: description
DataPoint.Doc: The message representation of the fault.

ModuleClass.name: filterInfo
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for monitoring filter information of a device.

DataPoint.name: usedTime
DataPoint.Doc: The cumulative used time in seconds of a filter.

DataPoint.name: needsReplacement
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates that the filter needs to be replaced.

DataPoint.name: filterLifetime
DataPoint.Doc: Percentage lifetime remaining for the water filter.

ModuleClass.name: foaming
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor desired parameters of foam e.g. for foaming milk. It is initially intended to be part of a device that prepare drinks with milk (for example a coffee machine or hot chocolate machine).

DataPoint.name: foamingStrength
DataPoint.Doc: The current strength of foamed milk. A higher value indicates more foamed milk.

ModuleClass.name: galleryMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information about the mode of display. The galleryMode includes the display orientation, display interval and display order.

DataPoint.name: displayOrientation
DataPoint.Doc: The orientation of display.

DataPoint.name: displayInterval
DataPoint.Doc: The interval of changing display content.

DataPoint.name: displayOrder
DataPoint.Doc: The sequence of the displaying content.

ModuleClass.name: gasChargingControl
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to recharge the gas meter.

DataPoint.name: billingNumber
DataPoint.Doc: The billing number of the remote recharge.

DataPoint.name: rechargeCredit
DataPoint.Doc: Amount of recharge money in local currency.

DataPoint.name: surplusCredit
DataPoint.Doc: Amount of surplus money in local currency.

DataPoint.name: rechargeGas
DataPoint.Doc: Percentage life time remaining for the water filter.

DataPoint.name: surplusGas
DataPoint.Doc: Amount of surplus gas.

ModuleClass.name: gasMeterAlarm
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set service parameters of a gas meter.

DataPoint.name: lowGasAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of insufficient amount of gas.

DataPoint.name: lowCreditAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of insufficient amount of money..

DataPoint.name: leakageAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of gas leakage.

DataPoint.name: lockedDownAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of the gas meter being locked. When the gas meter is in use, the lower wheel does not work, called the "dead meter".

DataPoint.name: largeFlowAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of large flow occurring. The instantaneous flow passed exceeds the setting maximum flow of the gas meter.

DataPoint.name: magneticDisturb
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of magnetic interference occurring.

DataPoint.name: singleCountAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of single reed switch counting. The normal condition is that the double reed switches are working. If only a single reed switch is working, it means that the metering has a problem and shall fire the alarm.

ModuleClass.name: gasMeterReportInfo
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information of measurements of a gas meter.

DataPoint.name: totalUseValue
DataPoint.Doc: The total consumption of gas.

DataPoint.name: valveStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The status of the gas meter valve. "True" means open, "False" means close.

ModuleClass.name: geoLocation
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to get or set geo-location information.

DataPoint.name: latitude
DataPoint.Doc: The current latitude part of a geo-location.

DataPoint.name: longitude
DataPoint.Doc: The current longitude part of a geo-location.

DataPoint.name: altitude
DataPoint.Doc: The optional current altitude part of a geo-location.

DataPoint.name: heading
DataPoint.Doc: The azimuth of a device measured in degrees to true north. North is 0.0 degrees, east is 90,0 degrees, south is 180,0 degrees, west is 270,0 degrees. A negative value indicates an unknown heading.

DataPoint.name: horizontalAccuracy
DataPoint.Doc: The optional current horizontal accuracy of the geo-location. It describes a radius around the latitude/longitude coordinate.

DataPoint.name: verticalAccuracy
DataPoint.Doc: The optional current vertical accuracy of the altitude.

DataPoint.name: headingAccuracy
DataPoint.Doc: The optional current maximum deviation between the heading and the true geomagnetic heading.

DataPoint.name: targetLatitude
DataPoint.Doc: The optional target latitude part of a geo-location. This can be used to move a device to a new location.

DataPoint.name: targetLongitude
DataPoint.Doc: The optional target longitude part of a geo-location. This can be used to move a device to a new location.

DataPoint.name: targetAltitude
DataPoint.Doc: The optional target altitude part of a geo-location. This can be used to move a device to a new altitude.

ModuleClass.name: glucometer
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of glucose characteristics.

DataPoint.name: concentration
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of concentration by Glucometer.

DataPoint.name: hba1c
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of HbA1c by Glucometer.

DataPoint.name: contextExercise
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of context exercise by Glucometer.

DataPoint.name: contextMedication
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of context medication by Glucometer. The unit of measure is mg/dl.

DataPoint.name: contextCarbohydratesAmount
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of context carbohydrates by Glucometer.

DataPoint.name: contextCarbohydratesSource
DataPoint.Doc: The timing of meals (for example "breakfast carbohydrates").

DataPoint.name: contextMeal
DataPoint.Doc: The style of meals (for example "casual").

DataPoint.name: contextLocation
DataPoint.Doc: The body location where the Glucometer is worn (for example "finger").

DataPoint.name: contextTester
DataPoint.Doc: The test style (for example "self").

DataPoint.name: contextHealth
DataPoint.Doc: The severity of symptoms (for example "minor"),

ModuleClass.name: grinder
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass is for controlling a grinder, for example in a coffee machine.

DataPoint.name: useGrinder
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of the grinder enablement. "True" indicates enabled, and "False" indicates disabled.

DataPoint.name: coarseness
DataPoint.Doc: The wished coarseness of the solid supplies after grinding, for example for coffee beans.

DataPoint.name: grainsRemaining
DataPoint.Doc: The level of remaining grains in a machine having a grinder, for example for remaining coffee beans in the coffee machine grinder.

ModuleClass.name: headingSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate the heading (e.g. status of get-in and get-out) of a pedestrian or a vehicle which crossing a control point (e.g. entrance and gate).

DataPoint.name: heading
DataPoint.Doc: The azimuth of a device measured in degrees to true north. North is 0.0 degrees, east is 90.0 degrees, south is 180.0 degrees, west is 270.0 degrees. A negative value indicates an unknown heading.

DataPoint.name: headingAccuracy
DataPoint.Doc: The optional current maximum deviation between the heading and the true geomagnetic heading.

ModuleClass.name: heatingZone
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to monitor the status of the heating zone, for example for a cooktop.

DataPoint.name: heatingLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The current heating level of the zone. The value range is from 0 (indicating that the zone is not heating) up to the maxHeatingLevel.

DataPoint.name: maxHeatingLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The maximum value allowed for the heating level of the zone.

ModuleClass.name: height
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of height.

DataPoint.name: height
DataPoint.Doc: The height measurement.

ModuleClass.name: hotWaterSupply
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the information about the status of supplying hot water into tanks or bath tubes.

DataPoint.name: bath
DataPoint.Doc: The status of whether a bath tub is filled.

ModuleClass.name: impactSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass describes the capabilities on an impact sensor. The impact is a high force or shock over a short time period and the impactSensor detects this.

DataPoint.name: impactStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The "impactStatus" indicates as follows: "True" means that a physical impact is detected, "False" means indicates a normal status (no impact detected).

DataPoint.name: impactLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The "impactLevel" provides the level of impact.

DataPoint.name: impactDirectionHorizontal
DataPoint.Doc: The "impactDirection" indicates the horizontal direction where the impact comes from. The value is 0 to 360 degrees. 0 degrees is the front of the sensor and with clockwise increment.

DataPoint.name: impactDirectionVertical
DataPoint.Doc: The "impactDirection" indicates the vertical direction where the impact comes from. The value is 0 to 360 degrees. 0 degrees is the front of the sensor and with upward increment.

ModuleClass.name: infraredSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate whether or not an object has been sensed.

DataPoint.name: detectedValue
DataPoint.Doc: The "detectedValue" indicates as follows: "True" means that an object is detected, "False" means no object is detected.

DataPoint.name: detectedTime
DataPoint.Doc: The time when the object was detected.

ModuleClass.name: keepWarm
ModuleClass.Doc: This module allows to control the 'keep warm' feature in devices like coffee machines, kettles etc. It allows to keep water warm for a desired time. This ModuleClass inherits from binarySwitch to store setting for the 'keep warm' feature. If the "powerState" data point in a keepWarmSwitch is "True" then the 'keep warm' function will be performed just after boiling (or heating) process is finished (otherwise this function will not be applied).

DataPoint.name: time
DataPoint.Doc: The desired duration of 'keep water warm' function. It indicates how long water shall be kept warm, for example after the boiling in a kettle.

DataPoint.name: targetTemperature
DataPoint.Doc: Content temperature.

ModuleClass.name: keypad
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to perform a user defined service through the key-in number. For example, a user can define key 1 as "perform a takeout from a restaurant with combo meal 1". The IoT service provider or user can define the services.

DataPoint.name: keyNumber
DataPoint.Doc: The number of the pressed key.

ModuleClass.name: liquidLevel
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the desired level of water (or other liquid) for an appliance, for example the desired level of milk for a cup of coffee from a coffee machine.

DataPoint.name: liquidLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The desired level of water or other liquid, for example the desired level of milk in a cup of coffee.

ModuleClass.name: liquidRemaining
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the status of water level (or other liquid) for an appliance, for example the level of remaining milk in a coffee machine.

DataPoint.name: liquidRemaining
DataPoint.Doc: The remaining level of water or other liquid in an appliance.

ModuleClass.name: lock
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the function to lock and unlock an object.

DataPoint.name: lock
DataPoint.Doc: "True" indicates the object is locked, while "False" indicates the object is not locked.

ModuleClass.name: magneticSensorParameters
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set service parameters for parking detectors..

DataPoint.name: detectionInterval
DataPoint.Doc: Time interval for detecting the geomagnetic field strength.

DataPoint.name: initialMagnetic
DataPoint.Doc: The value of initial geomagnetic field strength, which is usually set when the parking detector is initially installed. It may be reset later if the geomagnetic field strength of the local environment is affected by other factors. The value is used as the reference threshold to determine the parkingStatus. When the parking detector detects that the strength of the magnetic field is greater than the initialMagnetic, the parkingStatus is set to "true", otherwise, the parkingStatus is set to "false".

DataPoint.name: magneticSensitivityLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The level of detection sensitivity. It is implementation specific.

DataPoint.name: highMagneticAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of high magnetic interference. The alarm threshold is implementation specific.

ModuleClass.name: mediaSelect
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor media input and output of device such as TV or SetTopBox.

DataPoint.name: mediaID
DataPoint.Doc: The numeric index of the activated media in the supported media sources list "supportedMediaSources".

DataPoint.name: supportedMediaSources
DataPoint.Doc: List of supported input or output media for the given device.

DataPoint.name: mediaName
DataPoint.Doc: Specifies a pre-defined media input or output.

DataPoint.name: status
DataPoint.Doc: Specifies whether the specific media instance is selected ("True") or not ("False").

DataPoint.name: mediaType
DataPoint.Doc: Specifies the type of the media.

ModuleClass.name: motionSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate the occurrence of motion and raising of an alarm if the triggering criterion is met.

DataPoint.name: alarm
DataPoint.Doc: The detection of the motion occurrence.

DataPoint.name: silentTime
DataPoint.Doc: The time that a motionSensor restrains from sending an alarm in case continuous motions are detected after one alarm is produced. This data point can be used to avoid repeated alarm reports.

DataPoint.name: sensitivity
DataPoint.Doc: The level of the detection accuracy of the motion sensor. This data point can be used to control the number of the report.

ModuleClass.name: numberValue
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to represent a number. It also has capabilities for controlled increment and decrement a counter. It can be used to present a number-related functionality in a technology where there is only a weak semantic specification of that functionality.

Action.name: decrementNumberValue
Action.Doc: Decrement the "numberValue" by the value of "step", down to the value of "minimum".

Action.name: incrementNumberValue
Action.Doc: Increment the "numberValue" by the value of "stepValue", up to the value of "maxValue".

Action.name: resetNumberValue
Action.Doc: Reset the "numberValue" to its "defaultValue".

DataPoint.name: numberValue
DataPoint.Doc: The actual value of the number.

DataPoint.name: minValue
DataPoint.Doc: The optional minimum value of the number. The default is the system-specific minimum value for a float value.

DataPoint.name: maxValue
DataPoint.Doc: The optional maximum value of the number. The default is the system-specific maximum value for a float value.

DataPoint.name: defaultValue
DataPoint.Doc: The optional default value for the number. The default is 0,0.

DataPoint.name: step
DataPoint.Doc: The optional step size for controlled increment and decrement. The default is 1,0, even when this data point is not implemented.

ModuleClass.name: openLevel
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to control and monitor the open status of an entity, for example a curtain.

Action.name: open
Action.Doc: Increase the open level by the amount of the "stepValue" up to the "maxLevel".

Action.name: close
Action.Doc: Decrease the open level by the amount of the "stepValue" down to the "minLevel".

DataPoint.name: openLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The rounded percentage of the current open level of entity in the range of [0, 100]. 0 percentage shall mean the entity is closed.

DataPoint.name: stepValue
DataPoint.Doc: The step value used by the "open" and "close" actions.

DataPoint.name: minLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The minimum value allowed for the "openLevel" status. The default value is 0, which means fully closed.

DataPoint.name: maxLevel
DataPoint.Doc: The maximum value allowed for the "openLevel" status. The default value is 100, which means fully opened.

ModuleClass.name: operationMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control or monitor the operation mode of appliances.

DataPoint.name: startPause
DataPoint.Doc: A value of "True" triggers or starts an operation, and "False" pauses the operation.

ModuleClass.name: overcurrentSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for an over-current sensor.

DataPoint.name: overcurrentStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The overcurrentStatus indicates as follows: "True" indicates that an over-current is detected, and "False" indicates a normal status, this means that an over-current is not detected.

DataPoint.name: detectedTime
DataPoint.Doc: The time when the over-current was detected.

DataPoint.name: duration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of the detected over-current. The unit of measure is "ms".

ModuleClass.name: oximeter
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of blood oxygen characteristics.

DataPoint.name: oxygenSaturation
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of oxygensaturation by Oximeter. The unit of measure is in percentage.

ModuleClass.name: ozoneMeter
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for an ozone meter. The "ozoneValue…" attributes are optional, but one of them SHALL be provided.

DataPoint.name: ozoneStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The ozoneStatus indicates the level of ozone status.

DataPoint.name: maxValue
DataPoint.Doc: The maximum value shows the measurement range of the ozone meter (for example maxValue=5 means the range is 0 to 5 ppm). This attribute is only used that the ozone meter provides "ppm" value.

ModuleClass.name: parkingStatus
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the status of the parking detector.

DataPoint.name: parkingStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the status of the parking space. "False" means not occupied, "True" means occupied.

ModuleClass.name: periodicalReportConfig
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set parameters of periodic report.

DataPoint.name: backoffTime
DataPoint.Doc: The number of seconds to wait before connecting to network.

DataPoint.name: period
DataPoint.Doc: Reporting period.

DataPoint.name: retryTimes
DataPoint.Doc: The maximum number of re-sent attempts in the case of report failure.

DataPoint.name: retryInterval
DataPoint.Doc: The minimum time interval between each message transmission retry.

ModuleClass.name: phoneCall
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability get or set the caller and recipient IDs as well as to initiate and terminate a call.

Action.name: call
Action.Doc: Initiate an outgoing call.

Action.name: answer
Action.Doc: Answer (pickup) an incoming call.

Action.name: hangup
Action.Doc: Hangup an established call.

DataPoint.name: callerID
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the initiating caller identiﬁcation of a call. In case of an outgoing call this would be the local line ID. This data point is optional. When it is empty for an incoming call, then the caller ID is unknown. When it is empty for an outgoing call, then it is expected that it is set by the PBX or the operator. The format of caller ID is not speciﬁed here.

DataPoint.name: recipientID
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the receiving caller identiﬁcation of a call. In case of an incoming call this would be the local line ID and optionally extension. The format of caller ID is not speciﬁed here.

DataPoint.name: callState
DataPoint.Doc: This data point represents the current state of an associated phone device regarding calls.

ModuleClass.name: playerControl
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor the operational modes of a media player functionality.

Action.name: nextTrack
Action.Doc: Go forward to a next chapter, section or similar marker in the media.

Action.name: previousTrack
Action.Doc: Go back to a previous chapter, section or similar marker in the media.

DataPoint.name: currentPlayerMode
DataPoint.Doc: The current mode of the player.

DataPoint.name: currentPlayerModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of current player mode in string. This can be used when "currentPlayerMode" is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: supportedPlayerModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of supported modes for a player.

DataPoint.name: speedFactor
DataPoint.Doc: The optional factor of speeding up or slowing down playback, rewind or fast forward.

ModuleClass.name: powerSave
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to enable the power saving mode of a device and monitor the current status.

DataPoint.name: powerSaveEnabled
DataPoint.Doc: The current status of the power saving mode. "True" indicates enabled, and "False" indicates not enabled.

ModuleClass.name: prePaidCardReader
ModuleClass.Doc: The Pre-paid card reader ModuleClass provides functions to read NFC card and indicates its information.

DataPoint.name: readStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the status of reading the pre-paid card. “True” means the reader reads the pre-paid card successfully.

DataPoint.name: cardInfo
DataPoint.Doc: The card information is consisted of numbers of integer values. (1..N).

DataPoint.name: balance
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the balance of the pre-paid card.

DataPoint.name: currency
DataPoint.Doc: The currency is depended on the country which the card is used. For example, the unit could be "Dollar" or "$" in US, "Euro" in EU and "Won" in Korea.

ModuleClass.name: printQueue
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities for monitoring printing list information.

DataPoint.name: uri
DataPoint.Doc: The URI of the printing file. The URI could be "file://www.example.com/file.extension".

DataPoint.name: printingState
DataPoint.Doc: The printingState is indicating the status of the printing file.

ModuleClass.name: pulsemeter
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of pulse characteristics.

DataPoint.name: pulseRate
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of pulserate by pulse meter.

DataPoint.name: rr
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of RR interval by pulse meter.

DataPoint.name: energy
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of energy by pulse meter.

DataPoint.name: modality
DataPoint.Doc: The modality of a particular SpO2 measurement.

ModuleClass.name: pushButton
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to indicate the operation of a button style switch. A typical application can be an SOS button.

DataPoint.name: pushed
DataPoint.Doc: To indicate the press of the button.

ModuleClass.name: rainGauge
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to measure the height of fallen rain.

Action.name: resetGauge
Action.Doc: Empty the water container. Set the "height" value to 0.

DataPoint.name: gaugeHeight
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the number of mm of rainfall since the last reset of the device.

ModuleClass.name: recorder
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to record the video/audio for a defined duration.

DataPoint.name: duration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration for video/audio recording. Set to trigger the recorder

ModuleClass.name: refrigeration
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for a refrigeration function.

DataPoint.name: rapidFreeze
DataPoint.Doc: Controls the rapid freeze capability. "True" indicates active, "False" indicates inactive.

DataPoint.name: rapidCool
DataPoint.Doc: Controls the rapid cool capability. "True" indicates active, "False" indicates inactive.

DataPoint.name: defrost
DataPoint.Doc: Controls the defrost cycle. "True" indicates active, "False" indicates inactive.

DataPoint.name: deodorize
DataPoint.Doc: Controls the deodorize cycle. "True" indicates active, "False" indicates inactive.

DataPoint.name: degerm
DataPoint.Doc: Controls the degerm cycle. "True" indicates active, "False" indicates inactive.

ModuleClass.name: relativeHumidity
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability for the device to report the humidity based on a specified rule that is vendor dependent.

DataPoint.name: relativeHumidity
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of the relative humidity value.

DataPoint.name: desiredHumidity
DataPoint.Doc: Desired value for humidity. This data point indicates the desired humidity.

ModuleClass.name: remoteControlEnable
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to monitor the remote controllability of the appliance.

DataPoint.name: remoteControlEnabled
DataPoint.Doc: This data point enables or disables remote controllability and is set by a user locally. "True" indicates enabled remote access, and "False" indicates disabled remote access.

ModuleClass.name: robotCleanerJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of a robotCleaner.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: Currently active job mode (see clause 5.6.23).

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of current job mode as a string. This can be used when "currentJobMode" is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: runState
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and the monitor machine state of appliances.

DataPoint.name: currentMachineState
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active machine state.

DataPoint.name: machineStates
DataPoint.Doc: A list of possible machine states the device supports.

DataPoint.name: currentJobState
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active job state at the level of some transaction being executed by the device.

DataPoint.name: jobStates
DataPoint.Doc: The list of possible job states that the device supports.

DataPoint.name: progressPercentage
DataPoint.Doc: The indication of current job progress in percentage.

ModuleClass.name: securityMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor a security mode.

DataPoint.name: currentSecurityMode
DataPoint.Doc: Current security mode.

DataPoint.name: securityModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible security modes the device supports (see clause 5.6.24).

ModuleClass.name: sessionDescription
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities for a sessionDescription containing a URL at which the specified media can be accessed and the definition of media using SDP.

DataPoint.name: uri
DataPoint.Doc: A URL at which the specified media can be accessed.

DataPoint.name: sdp
DataPoint.Doc: Media description using SDP. One or more comma separated multiple SDP lines (SDP media or attribute line) can be included using SDP description syntax as defined in the SDP specification in IETF RFC4566.

ModuleClass.name: shoesWasherJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClasses provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of a shoesWasher.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: The currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of current job mode as a string. This can be used when "currentJobMode" is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: signalPanel
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass displays a signal (e.g. direction arrow) to indicate a gate is permitted to get-in or get-out on a panel.

DataPoint.name: signal
DataPoint.Doc: The signal is true, the panel indicates go forward signal or icon. If the signal is false, the panel displays stop signal or icon.

ModuleClass.name: signalStrength
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to monitor the strength of the signal.

DataPoint.name: lqi
DataPoint.Doc: The current value of link quality indicator, which reflects the scaling of rssi by dividing the received signal strength over reference signal strength. The common unit for lqi is percentage [0,100]. For the detailed definition, see IEEE 802.15.4 [i.4], clause 6.7.8.

DataPoint.name: rssi
DataPoint.Doc: The current value of received signal strength indicator, which reflects the raw signal level.

ModuleClass.name: slcAlarm
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to provide alarm information of street light controller.

DataPoint.name: overCurrentThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of over current.

DataPoint.name: overCurrentDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of over current to trigger the alarm.

DataPoint.name: underCurrentThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of under current.

DataPoint.name: underCurrentDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of under current to trigger the alarm.

DataPoint.name: overVoltageThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of over voltage.

DataPoint.name: overVoltageDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of over voltage to trigger the alarm.

DataPoint.name: underVoltageThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of under voltage.

DataPoint.name: underVoltageDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of under voltage to trigger the alarm.

DataPoint.name: overVoltagePercent
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of over current in terms of percentage. The value range is [0,100]. This is the alternative trigger of the overVoltageAlarm and should be mutually exclusive to the overVoltageThreshold.

DataPoint.name: underVoltagePercent
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of under current in terms of percentage. The value range is [0,100]. This is the alternative trigger of the underVoltageAlarm and should be mutually exclusive to the underVoltageThreshold.

DataPoint.name: standardreferenceVoltage
DataPoint.Doc: The reference voltage used as the basis of the overVoltagePercent and underVoltagePercent.

DataPoint.name: overCurrentAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of over current.

DataPoint.name: underCurrentAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of under current.

DataPoint.name: overVoltageAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of over voltage.

DataPoint.name: underVoltageAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm of under voltage.

ModuleClass.name: slcParameterSetting
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set service parameters.

DataPoint.name: lightCount
DataPoint.Doc: Number of lampholders controlled by the street light controller.

DataPoint.name: timePlanStatus
DataPoint.Doc: "False" indicates the time plan is not used. "True" indicates the time plan is being used.

DataPoint.name: timeRangeCount
DataPoint.Doc: The number of time ranges for the time plan.

DataPoint.name: timeRange
DataPoint.Doc: An array of sequential time points which define the time plan. Each time point is the start time of the next time range as well as the end of previous time range in the time plan.

DataPoint.name: timeRangeLightDimmingValue
DataPoint.Doc: An array containing the dimming values in different time ranges. In the case that lightCount is larger than 1, it is a 2-dimentional array describing the dimming value of each lampholder in each time range. Editor's Note: the data type is FFS for this datapoint.

ModuleClass.name: slcReportInfo
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information of status of the street light controller.

DataPoint.name: voltageFrequency
DataPoint.Doc: The frequency of voltage.

DataPoint.name: switchStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the status of light switch. "False": off, "True": on.

DataPoint.name: onlineStatus
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the communication status of light. "False": offline, "True": online.

DataPoint.name: lightVoltage
DataPoint.Doc: The voltage of the street light controller.

DataPoint.name: lightCurrent
DataPoint.Doc: The current of the street light controller.

DataPoint.name: lightDimmingValue
DataPoint.Doc: The dimming value of the street light.

DataPoint.name: lightPowerFactor
DataPoint.Doc: The light power factor is the ratio of active power to apparent power. Power factor is a factor that measures the efficiency of electrical equipment. The value range is [0,1].

DataPoint.name: lightActivePower
DataPoint.Doc: Active power is the electrical power required to keep the electrical equipment running normally, that is, the electrical power that converts electrical energy into other forms of energy, such as mechanical, optical, thermal, and so on.

DataPoint.name: lightReactivePower
DataPoint.Doc: The reactive power is the electrical power required to establish an alternating magnetic field and induced magnetic flux.

DataPoint.name: lightApparentPower
DataPoint.Doc: This value indicates the apparent power that is mainly used to calculate the energy consumption of the street light.

DataPoint.name: lightPolarizationAxis
DataPoint.Doc: The angle of the polarization axis in case street light devices support this feature. The PolarizationAxis is measured starting from Editors Note: DESCRIPTION NEEDED

DataPoint.name: colourTemperature
DataPoint.Doc: The current colour temperature of the street lights.

DataPoint.name: lampTechnology
DataPoint.Doc: A string that indicates the type of lamp technology that is used in the street lamps, e.g. "LED", "Tungsten", etc.

ModuleClass.name: smokeSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate the detection of smoke and raising an alarm if the triggering criterion is met.

Action.name: muteSmokeSensor
Action.Doc: Mute the smoke sensor alarm.

Action.name: test
Action.Doc: Testing the alarm.

DataPoint.name: alarm
DataPoint.Doc: The alarm is indicated as follows: "True" indicates that smoke has been detected, "False" indicates a normal status, that means that smoke is not detected.

DataPoint.name: detectedTime
DataPoint.Doc: The date and time the smoke is detected.

DataPoint.name: smokeThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold to trigger the alarm. The unit of measure is ppm.

DataPoint.name: currentValue
DataPoint.Doc: The current data value of the smoke sensor.

DataPoint.name: sensorFault
DataPoint.Doc: "True" indicates the sensor fault status of smoke sensor. "False" indicates the sensor fault of smoke sensor has been eliminated.

DataPoint.name: lowVoltage
DataPoint.Doc: "True" indicates the low voltage status of smoke sensor. "False" indicates the low voltage alarm of smoke sensor has been eliminated.

DataPoint.name: dismantled
DataPoint.Doc: "True" indicates the smoke sensor is dismantled. "False" indicates the dismantled alarm of smoke sensor has been eliminated.

DataPoint.name: powerOn
DataPoint.Doc: True" indicates the smoke sensor is powered on. "False" is invalid.

ModuleClass.name: sphygmomanometer
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to report the measurement of blood pressure characteristics.

DataPoint.name: diastolicPressure
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of diastolic pressure by sphygmomanometer.

DataPoint.name: systolicPressure
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of systolic pressure by sphygmomanometer.

DataPoint.name: meanPressure
DataPoint.Doc: The measurement of mean arterial pressure by sphygmomanometer.

ModuleClass.name: spinLevel
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor the level of spin. It is intended to be part of devices which use spinning function such as a washing machine and a dryer.

DataPoint.name: spinLevelStrength
DataPoint.Doc: The value of spin-dry level. A higher value indicates a higher spin level.

ModuleClass.name: steamClosetJobMode
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to control and monitor the job modes of steamCloset.

DataPoint.name: currentJobMode
DataPoint.Doc: Currently active job mode.

DataPoint.name: currentJobModeName
DataPoint.Doc: Name of current job mode as a string. This can be used when "currentJobMode" is vendor-specific.

DataPoint.name: jobModes
DataPoint.Doc: List of possible job states the device supports.

ModuleClass.name: televisionChannel
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set and get channels of a device that has a channel list.

Action.name: upChannel
Action.Doc: Change the current channel to the next channel in the stored list of available channels. If the current channel is the last one in the list, the new set channel may be the first one in the list.

Action.name: downChannel
Action.Doc: Change the current channel to the previous channel in the stored list of available channels. If the current channel is the first one in the list, the new set channel may be the last one in the list.

DataPoint.name: channelNumber
DataPoint.Doc: Current channel number.

DataPoint.name: availableChannels
DataPoint.Doc: The list of available channel numbers which may be built by automatic scan and/or manual selection.

DataPoint.name: previousChannel
DataPoint.Doc: The channel number which was selected previously.

DataPoint.name: channelName
DataPoint.Doc: Current human-friendly channel name in string, for example 'CNN'.

ModuleClass.name: temperature
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to represent the current temperature and target temperature of devices such as an air conditioner, refrigerator, oven, etc.

DataPoint.name: currentTemperature
DataPoint.Doc: The current temperature.

DataPoint.name: targetTemperature
DataPoint.Doc: The desired temperature to reach.

DataPoint.name: unit
DataPoint.Doc: The default is Celsius (C).

DataPoint.name: minValue
DataPoint.Doc: Minimum value of "targetTemperature".

DataPoint.name: maxValue
DataPoint.Doc: Maximum value of "targetTemperature".

DataPoint.name: stepValue
DataPoint.Doc: Step value allowed for "targetTemperature".

ModuleClass.name: temperatureAlarm
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capabilities to indicate the detection of abnormal temperatures and raises an alarm if the triggering criterion is met.

DataPoint.name: unit
DataPoint.Doc: The default is Celsius (C).

DataPoint.name: temperature
DataPoint.Doc: To report the value of the temperature.

DataPoint.name: highTemperatureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: High temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: highTemperatureAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of maximum temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowTemperatureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Low temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowTemperatureAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of minimum temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: alarmTimestamp
DataPoint.Doc: The timestamp since the alarm is active.

ModuleClass.name: textMessage
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to set and get a text message.

Action.name: resetTextMessage
Action.Doc: Reset the receiver of the message to the "defaultValue".

DataPoint.name: textMessage
DataPoint.Doc: The current message value.

DataPoint.name: supportedMessageValues
DataPoint.Doc: List of supported values for the message. Each of the values in this list shall be URL-encoded. An encoded value shall not contain white spaces.

DataPoint.name: minLength
DataPoint.Doc: The optional minimum length in characters of the message. The default is 0.

DataPoint.name: maxLength
DataPoint.Doc: The optional maximum length in characters of the message. The default is unlimited.

DataPoint.name: messageEncoding
DataPoint.Doc: The optional expected method for character encoding of the message. The default is "UTF8".

DataPoint.name: defaultValue
DataPoint.Doc: The optional default value for "textMessage". The default is an empty string.

ModuleClass.name: timer
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities to monitor and control the times when the appliance executes its operations, that means when it starts, when it ends, etc.

Action.name: activateClockTimer
Action.Doc: Activate current clock timer.

Action.name: deactivateClockTimer
Action.Doc: Deactivate current clock timer.

DataPoint.name: referenceTimer
DataPoint.Doc: A timer (for example. a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Progressive) expressed in seconds. The value indicates a time counter to be used as reference for the other time-based data points of this ModuleClass. Usually it is the time since the last event of power-on of the producer (or more in detail the since the boot of its connectivity node).

DataPoint.name: targetTimeToStart
DataPoint.Doc: A time span (for example a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Fixed) expressed in seconds. The value indicates the time when the appliance is expected to start its operation, starting counting from the last "referenceTimer".

DataPoint.name: targetTimeToStop
DataPoint.Doc: A time span (for example a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Fixed) expressed in seconds. The value indicates the time when the appliance is expected to stop its operation, starting counting from the last "referenceTimer".

DataPoint.name: estimatedTimeToEnd
DataPoint.Doc: A timer (for example a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Progressive) expressed in seconds. The value indicates the time to the end of an appliance's operations. It is calculated at runtime by the device itself during the execution of its operation.

DataPoint.name: runningTime
DataPoint.Doc: A timer (for example a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Progressive) expressed in seconds. It indicates the time of the current operation. Usually its value is increasing one value per second. It starts counting from 0 when the operation starts and stops counting when the operation ends.

DataPoint.name: targetDuration
DataPoint.Doc: A time span (for a time-based value, App Defined Epoch, Fixed) expressed in seconds. The value indicates a time that represents the target duration of the operation as per user selection.

DataPoint.name: absoluteStartTime
DataPoint.Doc: An absolute time to specify the start time.

DataPoint.name: absoluteStopTime
DataPoint.Doc: An absolute time to specify the stop time.

ModuleClass.name: touchScreen
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides the capability to get selections of a user from the pre-defined menus on the screen as parts of a process of charging transportation payment card of the user.

DataPoint.name: pushed
DataPoint.Doc: This data point indicates the press of the button. (1..N)

DataPoint.name: positionX

DataPoint.name: positionY

ModuleClass.name: turbo

DataPoint.name: turboEnabled

ModuleClass.name: uvSensor
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass describes the capabilities of an ultraviolet sensor.

DataPoint.name: uvStatus
DataPoint.Doc: The "uvStatus" indicates the level of the UV radiation status (see clause 5.6.30).

ModuleClass.name: waterFilterType
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass indicates the type of the water purifier.

DataPoint.name: filterType
DataPoint.Doc: The type of water purifier. list of Water Filter Type.

ModuleClass.name: waterFlow
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides capabilities for controlling the water strength of a device.

DataPoint.name: waterFlowStrength
DataPoint.Doc: The desired level of water flow. A higher value indicates higher water flow.

ModuleClass.name: waterMeterAlarm

DataPoint.name: highFlowAlarmThreshold

DataPoint.name: highFlowDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of high water flow.

DataPoint.name: highFlowAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Continuous high water flow alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowFlowAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of continuous low flow alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowFlowDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of low water flow.

DataPoint.name: lowFlowAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Continuous low water flow alarm.

DataPoint.name: reverseFlowAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of continuous reverse flow alarm.

DataPoint.name: reverseFlowDuration
DataPoint.Doc: The duration of reverse water flow.

DataPoint.name: reverseFlowAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Reverse flow alarm.

DataPoint.name: highPressureAlarmThreshold

DataPoint.name: highPressureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: High water pressure alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowPressureAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of low water pressure alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowPressureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Low water pressure alarm.

DataPoint.name: highTemperatureAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of maximum water temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: highTemperatureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: High water temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowTemperatureAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of minimum water temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: lowTemperatureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Low water temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: highTemperatureInnerAlarmThreshold
DataPoint.Doc: The threshold of high temperature alarm inside water meter.

DataPoint.name: innerHighInternalTemperatureAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Internal high temperature alarm.

DataPoint.name: innerErrorAlarm

DataPoint.name: innerTemperatureSensorFault

DataPoint.name: tamperAlarm

DataPoint.name: waterTemperatureSensorFault

DataPoint.name: pressureSensorFault
DataPoint.Doc: Pressure sensor failure.

DataPoint.name: communicationAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Communication abnormality alarm.

DataPoint.name: magneticInterference
DataPoint.Doc: Magnetic interference warning.

DataPoint.name: storageFault
DataPoint.Doc: Storage failure alarm.

DataPoint.name: urgencyButtonPush
DataPoint.Doc: Indicate the event of the urgency button being pushed. Pushing the urgency button may give a user a temporary right to still use the water meter (e.g. for 3 days) after an unpaid bill.

DataPoint.name: buttonFault

DataPoint.name: demolitionAlarm
DataPoint.Doc: Demolition sign.

DataPoint.name: impulseFault
DataPoint.Doc: Pulse anomaly flag.

DataPoint.name: vibrationSensorFault
DataPoint.Doc: Vibration sensor failure.

ModuleClass.name: waterMeterReportInfo
ModuleClass.Doc: This ModuleClass provides information of measurements of the watermeter.

DataPoint.name: dailyUseWaterTime
DataPoint.Doc: The total time of water consumption daily.

DataPoint.name: cumulativeFlow

DataPoint.name: cumulativeFlowDaily

DataPoint.name: positiveCumulativeFlow

DataPoint.name: peakFlowRate

DataPoint.name: lowestFlowRate

DataPoint.name: peakReverseFlowRate

DataPoint.name: lowestReverseFlowRate
DataPoint.Doc: Daily reverse lowest instantaneous water flow rate.

DataPoint.name: algae

DataPoint.name: as
DataPoint.Doc: Arsenic (As).

DataPoint.name: biotoxicity

DataPoint.name: bod

DataPoint.name: cod

DataPoint.name: conductivity
DataPoint.Doc: Conductivity is a parameter used to describe the ease of charge flow in a substance.

DataPoint.name: cd

DataPoint.name: chlorophyll_a

DataPoint.name: cn
DataPoint.Doc: Cyanide (CN).

DataPoint.name: cu
DataPoint.Doc: Cuprum (Cu).

DataPoint.name: f

DataPoint.name: fe

DataPoint.name: no3n
